about_the_game:
Where creativity meets immersion.

Step into a universe of limitless possibilities with VR4Life, the ultimate platform where creators and explorers connect through community-made virtual worlds.

Whether you're a 3D artist, developer, or just someone who loves immersive content, VR4Life lets you upload your own virtual environments made in tools like Blender and share them with the world. Build interactive scenes, games, or artistic spaces and make them accessible to a global audience.

Not a creator? No problem. Dive into a growing library of virtual experiences crafted by the community. Explore unique environments, play in experimental worlds, or simply relax and discover what others have imagined.

Key Features:

  • Upload custom-made VR worlds from Blender and other 3D tools

  • Browse and explore a wide variety of user-generated virtual spaces

  • Personalized creator pages and community feedback

  • Fully immersive and optimized for Meta headsets

  • A creative and social platform for both makers and explorers

VR4Life turns creativity into reality. Explore. Create. Live.

name: VR4life

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: OpenXR/SteamVR, Meta Quest 2 or Meta Quest 3 via Oculus Link / Air Link
  • Additional Notes: A VR-capable PC is required. Stable USB or Wi-Fi connection for Quest Link or Air Link is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: OpenXR/SteamVR, Meta Quest 2 or Meta Quest 3 via Oculus Link / Air Link
  • Additional Notes: For the best VR experience, use a high-quality USB-C cable or a strong Wi-Fi 6 connection for wireless play.

short_description: VR4Life is a virtual reality hub where users can explore or publish immersive worlds built with 3D modeling tools. Create, share, and experience the future of VR.
